tracks.name: General English
tracks.description: Jalur inti Linguora: grammar, kosakata, dan empat keterampilan bahasa untuk komunikasi sehari-hari dari A1 hingga C2.
goals: Berkomunikasi dengan percaya diri dalam situasi sehari-hari
Menguasai grammar inti secara bertahap sesuai CEFR
Membangun kosakata aktif yang relevan dengan kehidupan nyata

tracks.name: English for Academic Purposes
tracks.description: Untuk pelajar dan calon mahasiswa: membaca teks akademik, menulis esai, presentasi, dan bahasa formal.
goals: Menulis paragraf dan esai argumentatif yang terstruktur
Menggunakan register formal dan hedging dengan tepat

tracks.name: Business English
tracks.description: Bahasa Inggris untuk dunia kerja: email profesional, rapat, negosiasi, presentasi, dan small talk bisnis.
goals: Berpartisipasi aktif dalam rapat dan negosiasi
Menguasai kosakata bisnis dan kolokasi umum

tracks.name: English for Career Development
tracks.description: Persiapan karier: CV, wawancara kerja, personal branding, dan komunikasi di tempat kerja internasional.
goals: Menyusun CV dan cover letter berbahasa Inggris
Menjawab pertanyaan wawancara kerja dengan struktur yang jelas
Berkomunikasi profesional dengan rekan kerja internasional

levels.name: Beginner
levels.description: Mengenal dasar-dasar bahasa Inggris: memperkenalkan diri, angka, kegiatan sehari-hari, dan kalimat sederhana.
objectives: Memperkenalkan diri dan orang lain dengan kalimat sederhana
Menggunakan to be, present simple, dan present continuous dasar
Memahami dan menggunakan sekitar 500 kata yang paling umum
Membaca teks pendek sederhana tentang topik sehari-hari
levels.explanationLanguage: Penjelasan 90% bahasa Indonesia; contoh dan istilah kunci dalam bahasa Inggris.

units.title: Hello! Introducing Yourself
units.vocabulary: greetings, countries, nationalities, alphabet & spelling names

units.title: My Family and Me
grammar: to be: negative and yes/no questions
units.skills: talk about family, ask personal questions

units.title: Numbers, Time and Dates
units.skills: tell the time, say dates and phone numbers

units.title: Likes, Dislikes and Questions
grammar: wh- questions (what, where, when, who, why, how)
units.skills: ask and answer about habits and preferences

units.title: Food and Shopping
units.vocabulary: food, drinks, containers, prices, shopping phrases
units.skills: order food, buy things in a shop

units.title: Places in Town
units.skills: describe a town, ask for and give directions

units.title: Abilities and Free Time
grammar: object pronouns (me, him, her, us, them)
units.skills: talk about abilities, make simple requests

units.title: What Are You Doing Right Now?
units.skills: describe what is happening now, talk about the weather

levels.name: Elementary
levels.description: Menceritakan pengalaman masa lalu, membuat rencana, membandingkan, dan berkomunikasi dalam situasi rutin.
objectives: Menceritakan kejadian masa lalu dengan past simple
Membicarakan rencana masa depan dengan going to dan will
Membandingkan orang, tempat, dan benda
Berinteraksi dalam situasi rutin: perjalanan, kesehatan, pekerjaan
levels.explanationLanguage: Penjelasan 75% bahasa Indonesia, 25% bahasa Inggris sederhana.

units.title: Where Were You?
units.skills: talk about where you were in the past

units.title: Last Weekend
grammar: past simple regular verbs (-ed spelling and pronunciation)
units.skills: describe a past weekend or holiday

units.title: Telling Stories
grammar: sequencers: first, then, after that, finally
units.skills: tell a simple story in order

units.title: Comparing Things
units.vocabulary: adjectives for people, places and products

units.title: Plans for the Future
grammar: be going to for plans and predictions
will for instant decisions and offers
units.skills: make plans, invite and respond to invitations

units.title: Travel and Transport
units.skills: book a hotel, describe a travel experience

units.title: Have You Ever...?
units.skills: ask about and describe life experiences

units.title: Work and Jobs
grammar: verb + to-infinitive (want to, need to, would like to)
much / many / a lot of / a little / a few
units.skills: describe a job, talk about work preferences

units.title: Everyday Communication
grammar: polite requests: Could you...? / Would you like...?
common phrasal verbs (get up, turn on, look for)
units.skills: make phone calls, write a short informal email

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.description: Mengekspresikan pendapat, menceritakan pengalaman secara rinci, dan menangani sebagian besar situasi perjalanan dan pekerjaan.
objectives: Menggunakan present perfect, narrative tenses, dan berbagai bentuk future dengan tepat
Menggunakan conditional pertama dan kedua, passive dasar, dan relative clauses
Memahami poin utama teks dan percakapan tentang topik yang familier
Menulis teks terhubung sederhana tentang topik yang dikenal

units.title: Life Changes
units.skills: talk about recent news and life changes

units.title: Stories and Narratives
units.skills: tell a story with background and sequence

units.title: Looking Ahead
grammar: will vs be going to vs present continuous
future time clauses (when, as soon as, before, after)
units.skills: make predictions and discuss future plans

units.title: Imagine That
units.skills: talk about imaginary situations and wishes

units.title: Rules, Advice and Deduction
grammar: must / have to / need to / don't need to
must / might / can't for present deduction

units.title: People, Places and Things
grammar: defining relative clauses: who / which / that

units.title: Habits and Verb Patterns
grammar: be used to / get used to (introduction)
units.skills: talk about past habits and adapting to change

levels.name: Upper Intermediate
levels.description: Berkomunikasi dengan lancar dan spontan, memahami teks kompleks, dan menulis teks rinci dengan argumen yang jelas.
objectives: Menguasai perfect continuous, future perfect, dan conditional ketiga/campuran
Menggunakan passive lanjutan, causative, dan reported speech dengan reporting verbs
Menulis teks argumentatif dengan linking words yang beragam
Memahami ide utama teks kompleks tentang topik konkret maupun abstrak
levels.explanationLanguage: Penjelasan 70% bahasa Inggris, dengan ringkasan dan catatan bahasa Indonesia.

units.title: Ongoing Actions and Results
units.skills: describe ongoing situations and their results

units.title: The World in 2050
grammar: be about to / be due to / be likely to

units.title: Regrets and Alternatives
grammar: conditionals without if (otherwise, provided that, supposing)
units.skills: speculate about the past and its consequences

units.title: Getting Things Done
grammar: passive in all tenses and with modals
passive with reporting verbs (it is said that...)
units.skills: describe services and report information formally

units.title: Speculating About the Past
grammar: must have / might have / can't have + past participle
needn't have vs didn't need to

units.title: Building an Argument
grammar: contrast: although / despite / in spite of / whereas
purpose and result: so that / in order to / so ... that / such ... that

units.title: Wishes and Preferences
grammar: would rather / it's time + past simple

units.title: Natural English at Work
grammar: verb + noun collocations (make / do / take / have)
phrasal verbs for work and study

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Menggunakan bahasa secara fleksibel dan efektif untuk keperluan sosial, akademik, dan profesional dengan struktur kompleks.
objectives: Menggunakan inversion, cleft sentences, dan participle clauses untuk penekanan dan gaya
Menulis teks akademik dengan hedging, nominalisation, dan register formal
Memahami teks panjang dan menuntut serta makna implisit
Mengekspresikan diri dengan lancar tanpa banyak mencari kata
levels.explanationLanguage: Penjelasan dalam bahasa Inggris; arti kosakata dan catatan penting dalam bahasa Indonesia.

units.title: Emphasis Through Inversion
grammar: negative adverbial inversion (Never have I..., Rarely does...)
not only ... but also with inversion
hardly / no sooner / scarcely ... when / than
units.skills: add emphasis in formal speech and writing

units.title: Focusing Information
grammar: all / the thing / the reason ... is

units.title: Distancing and Reporting
grammar: it is thought / believed / reported that ...
subject + is said / believed + to-infinitive (perfect infinitive)

units.title: Academic Caution
grammar: hedging with modals and verbs (may, appear to, tend to, suggest)
softening with adverbs (arguably, relatively, to some extent)

units.title: Beyond If
grammar: inverted conditionals (Had I known..., Should you need..., Were it not for...)
but for / if it hadn't been for
provided / providing / on condition that / supposing

units.title: Formal Register and Nominalisation
units.skills: rewrite informal text in an academic style

units.title: Cohesion and Discourse
grammar: discourse markers for argument (nevertheless, consequently, by contrast)
reference and substitution (the former, the latter, this, such)

units.title: Idioms and Fixed Expressions
grammar: binomials (pros and cons, by and large)
units.vocabulary: idioms for work, relationships and decisions
units.skills: understand and use common idioms appropriately

units.title: Nuanced Modality
grammar: the subjunctive (insist that he be, it is essential that)
modal verbs for nuanced meaning (would, could, might in polite distancing)
be to / be supposed to / be bound to

levels.name: Proficient
levels.description: Memahami hampir semua yang didengar dan dibaca, serta mengekspresikan diri secara spontan, sangat lancar, dan presisi.
objectives: Menggunakan struktur stilistik (fronting, ellipsis, substitution) secara alami
Membedakan nuansa makna, konotasi, dan register dengan presisi
Menganalisis teks kompleks termasuk nada, ironi, dan argumen implisit
Menulis teks persuasif dan akademik yang canggih
levels.explanationLanguage: Penjelasan sepenuhnya dalam bahasa Inggris; arti kosakata tetap disertai bahasa Indonesia.

units.title: Fronting and Stylistic Inversion
grammar: fronting for emphasis (Strange as it may seem, ...)
inversion after place adverbials (Down came the rain)
so / such inversion (So severe was the damage that ...)

units.title: Ellipsis and Substitution
grammar: substitution with so, not, do so, one(s)

units.title: Advanced Word Formation
grammar: prefixes with nuanced meaning (mis-, under-, over-, counter-)
suffixes forming abstract nouns and adjectives

units.title: Shades of Meaning
grammar: gradable vs ungradable adjectives with intensifiers

units.title: Shifting Register
units.skills: adapt language to audience and purpose

units.title: Academic Precision
units.skills: write dense yet clear academic prose

units.title: Figurative Language
grammar: metaphor and simile in everyday English
idiomatic phrasal verbs with abstract meaning

units.title: Reading Between the Lines
units.skills: infer attitude and purpose in complex texts

units.title: Precision and Accuracy Mastery
grammar: common advanced errors (dangling modifiers, agreement in complex sentences)
